主要内容: BLONDER TONGUE LABORATORIES, INC. granted options to purchase 40,000 shares of the Company’s common stock to Nezam Nikoo, the Company’s Vice President of Engineering and CTO pursuant to an agreement dated April 3, 2017. The per share exercise price is $0.55, equal to the average of the high and low selling prices on the NYSE MKT on the grant date. Vesting is subject to performance-based criteria agreed by the Company and Mr. Nikoo.
